corrections.summary: The Skill archive digest recorded here is not reproducible. fflate renders the ZIP MS-DOS timestamp with local-time getters, and the packer handed it a fixed UTC instant, so the bytes depended on the packing machine's timezone. Measured: UTC stamped 1980-01-01 00:00, UTC+1 stamped 01:00, and every zone west of UTC stamped 1979 - below the year the format counts from - where the year field goes negative and reads back as 2107. One commit produced at least three different archives.
corrections.consequence: This digest identifies one machine's build, not the commit. It must not be used to establish that a later archive is the same artifact.
corrections.correctedBy: the packer now builds the stamp from local components fixed at 1980-01-01 00:00, verified identical across six timezones from UTC-11 to UTC+14
